messages.content:
How about a power-packed Halal omelette to kickstart your muscle gain? This dish delivers a high-protein punch to fuel your workouts and keep you feeling full.

**Halal Omelette**

| Food                              | Calories | Protein | Carbs | Fats |
| --------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----- | ---- |
| 3 Whole Eggs + 3 Egg Whites       | 270      | 30      | 3     | 15   |
| Spinach (1 cup)                   | 7        | 1       | 1     | 0    |
| Mushrooms (1/2 cup)               | 8        | 1       | 1     | 0    |
| Cheddar Cheese (30g, optional)    | 120      | 7       | 1     | 10   |
| Whole Wheat Toast (2 slices)      | 140      | 8       | 28    | 2    |
| **Totals**                        | **545**  | **47**  | **34**| **27** |

**Ingredients:**

*   3 whole eggs
*   3 egg whites
*   1 cup spinach, chopped
*   ½ cup mushrooms, sliced
*   30g cheddar cheese, shredded (optional)
*   2 slices whole wheat toast (Halal certified)
*   Salt and pepper to taste
*   Olive oil or coconut oil for cooking
*   Halal spices (cumin, turmeric, coriander)

**Instructions:**

1.  Whisk together the eggs, egg whites, salt, pepper, and selected Halal spices in a bowl.
2.  Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium heat. Sauté spinach and mushrooms until tender.
3.  Pour the egg mixture into the pan. Cook until the edges begin to set.
4.  Sprinkle cheese (if using) over one half of the omelette.
5.  Fold the omelette in half and cook until the cheese is melted and the eggs are cooked through.
6.  Serve hot with whole wheat toast on the side.

This omelette will help you reach 51% of your daily protein, keeps carbs at 28%, and brings you to around 85% of your daily fat intake.
